prompt:
State whether each of the following four quantities is a scalar or a vector:
(a) Acceleration
(b) Electrical resistance
(c) Momentum
(d) Temperature

answer.text:
(a) Acceleration: vector
(b) Electrical resistance: scalar
(c) Momentum: vector
(d) Temperature: scalar

mark_scheme: 2 marks for all 4 correct: (a) vector, (b) scalar, (c) vector, (d) scalar. (1 mark for 2 or 3 correct).
hints: Ask whether each quantity requires a spatial direction to be complete.
solution:
(a) Acceleration: vector
(b) Electrical resistance: scalar
(c) Momentum: vector
(d) Temperature: scalar
teacher_walkthrough: Step 1: Acceleration has magnitude and direction -> vector.
Step 2: Electrical resistance has magnitude only -> scalar.
Step 3: Momentum has magnitude and direction -> vector.
Step 4: Temperature has magnitude only -> scalar.
Step 5: Award 2 marks for all 4 correct.
exclusions: vector addition and resolution deferred to l11

abstract_patterns: distinguishing scalar and vector quantities and classification tables
provenance.independence_statement: Authored independently based on standard Cambridge AS Physics syllabus definitions and classification rubrics.
